Unreachable, not untested: utf16Len ranges over a Go string, and range decoding never yields a rune utf16.RuneLen rejects — an invalid UTF-8 sequence, including a UTF-8-encoded surrogate, decodes to utf8.RuneError (U+FFFD, one UTF-16 unit), and no decoded rune exceeds unicode.MaxRune.
